ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the [# day of August, 2023, by and between 510 FIFTH PROPCO LLC (together with its successors and assigns, “Lower Parcel Owner"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an office at c/o Metro, 2500 Enterprise Drive, Allen Park, Michigan 48101 and 510 FIFTH AVENUE LLC (together with its successors and assigns, “Air Space Owner"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Vornado Realty Trust,888SeventhAvenue,NewYork,NewYork10019. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Air Space Owner has, immediately prior to this Agreement, by deed Lower Parcel Owner is the fee owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, which lies below a limiting plane (the “Limiting Plane") located at an elevation of 255.00 feet above Manhattan Datum Level (as hereinafter defined), located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 40 in Block 1258 on the Tax Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lower Parcel Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the “Lower Parcel Building"; and the Lower Parcel Land and the Lower Parcel Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Lower Parcel"); WHEREAS, Air Space Owner is the fee owner of that certain volume of air which lies at and above the Limiting Plane, located within the boundaries of the Lower Parcel Land, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 9040 in Block 1258 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, and as and by the street address 510 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described WHEREAS, the Lower Parcel Building contains less “floor area" (as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution), than is now available for use on the Lower Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to the Air Space Parcel and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution so as to make available the willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Air Space Owner in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Air Space Owner intends to, in the future, (A) convey the Excess Development Rights by one or more transactions, to (i) one or more parcels of land (each, a "Developer Land") located within Block 1258 on the Tax Map (such parcels of land, together with any present or future buildings and improvements thereon, and any future replacements thereof, each, a “Developer Parcel"; the owner of any such Developer Parcel from time to time, each, together with its successors and assigns, a “Developer"), and/or (i) other parcels of land (each an “Additional Parcel" and collectively, the “Additional Parcels") that are or will be KL33506972.7
